sha256 / bytes are the real values of the released files; the downloader

wrote the checkpoint under (config.py profiles + ablations, run_*.sh).

checkpoints.name: rootquant-v2-weights
checkpoints.description: HEADLINE model. 896 px, DoRA(r=32) on attention + Mona on the MLP branch, backbone fully frozen, readout=both, EMA, D4 TTA. Trained on the mixed soybean+maize split. Use this one unless you have a reason not to.

checkpoints.name: rootquant-v2-768px
checkpoints.description: 768 px, DoRA(r=16) + Mona, huber(3), softplus-GeM, EMA, TTA, readout=both. The configuration between the 640 px DoRA-only baseline and the headline model. Trained without tile-shuffle.

checkpoints.name: rootquant-v2-dora-only
checkpoints.description: Headline recipe with the Mona adapter removed; DoRA untouched. The matched control for isolating the convolutional adapter.

checkpoints.name: rootquant-v2-unfreeze-last2
checkpoints.description: Headline architecture plus the MLP, LayerNorm and LayerScale weights of the last two ViT blocks unfrozen at a low LR. Attention stays frozen behind the DoRA buffer. Trained without tile-shuffle.

checkpoints.name: rootquant-v2-soybean-only
checkpoints.description: Headline architecture trained on the soybean-only split (phase 1 of run_cross_species.sh), without tile-shuffle.

checkpoints.name: rootquant-v2-soybean-to-maize-fcft
checkpoints.description: Warm-started from rootquant-v2-soybean-only and fine-tuned on maize with the feature extractor frozen — only the regression readout trains (FCFT). The file holds the complete adapter set: the frozen soybean-only DoRA / Mona / pooler weights plus the maize-trained readout. Trained without tile-shuffle.

checkpoints.name: rootquant-v2-soybean-to-maize-fft
checkpoints.description: Warm-started from rootquant-v2-soybean-only and fully fine-tuned on maize (FFT) — the whole warm-started adapter set trains. Trained without tile-shuffle.

checkpoints.name: rootquant-v2-dora-baseline-640px
checkpoints.description: 640 px, DoRA on attention and MLP, no Mona, cls_mean_max pool, global readout. 1.2 GB because this early checkpoint format stores the frozen backbone inline instead of rebuilding it at load time.
